oracle_protocol: observer on executed full-bank rows only; complete oracle is null for sparse streams
latency_protocol: synchronized finite-stream runner with frozen cache and one-input lookahead TD; no annotation delay; not a live-service benchmark
timing_protocol: synchronized wall time; prediction includes frozen-cache construction; update includes Context/classifier, reward probes and selector learning; excludes model loading, initialization, endpoint retention observers, file I/O and human label latency; other includes stream bookkeeping, oracle scoring and progress output

query_budget_bonus.scope: legal query action scores only; no forced labels, no reward/TD target change

paid_replay.sampling: uniform without replacement; recent/historical paid rows; excludes current

routing_oracle_audit.protocol: observer-only any-correct CNN/Context prediction before feedback; labels never select actions
routing_oracle_audit.scope: routing ceiling conditional on the evaluated query/adaptation trajectory; not global capacity

execution.context_count_protocol: matched Context count from dedicated policy-feedback sequence training
execution.audit_protocol: seed+8121 fixed source IDs excluded from every adaptation domain; observer-only labels
execution.continuation_protocol: all adaptive state retained; label budget recharged per domain

training_protocol.selection_metric: final persistent VAL audit accuracy minus excess clean-drop penalty
training_protocol.reset: bank/memory reset per TRAIN pass; all adaptive state retained within each sequence

selector_specialization.warm_start: inherited shared selector weights and initial Context
selector_specialization.context: paid-label adaptation within each sequence; reset to inherited initial state per epoch
selector_specialization.supervision: TRAIN anchors and acquired labels only; no unqueried-label supervision
selector_specialization.validation: temporary policy-feedback learner; disjoint observer-only VAL audit
selector_specialization.frozen_parameters: correctness and future heads; exact inherited weights
selector_specialization.optimizer: Adam update_value only; paired objective only; absolute TD diagnostic has no gradient
selector_specialization.evaluation: ordinary paid-feedback online adaptation of all selector heads

temporal_credit.boundary: next-domain first adaptation features; budget recharged; no next label
temporal_credit.evaluation: ordinary online selector losses; connected boundaries only for persistent sequences
temporal_credit.diagnostics: sampled TRAIN replay targets; rows may be counted repeatedly
